brief: Renders the events of a score once each into sound buffers that the offline render and the live scheduler share.
detail: Every event is rendered by its instrument, and the same note (same instrument, pitch, length, velocity and stroke) is rendered only once however often it recurs, because a wind instrument tunes itself by listening and that is slow. Plan lists a start frame and a buffer id per event; Offline mixes the plan into one stereo sound at 48000 Hz. An instrument that refuses a note, such as a glide on a pluck, is counted in Refusals and the note is missing from the plan. Nothing here opens an audio device. The sound has not been heard by a person (UNPERCEIVED): it is checked by frame count, sample rate and peak level.
receiver: o1 = new stzSoundScoreRenderer(StzSoundScoreOfQ("c e c e"))
